job.job_description:
Role: Head - Voice AI & Generative AI - Demand Generation




Location: Mumbai
Experience: 15+ Years
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent




About the Role

Looking for a senior Voice AI / Generative AI leader to build and lead its Voice AI-led Demand Generation and Customer Acquisition practice.




This is a high-ownership leadership role for a professional who combines Voice AI, Conversational AI, Generative AI, CRM, Marketing Automation, Digital Marketing and Enterprise Solution Architecture.




The ideal candidate should have 15+ years of overall technology/customer acquisition experience and at least 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade Voice AI or Conversational AI solutions in enterprise environments.




Key Responsibilities

Build and lead the Voice AI and Generative AI practice, including solution architecture, technology strategy, delivery standards and implementation frameworks.
Design end-to-end AI-led customer acquisition and demand generation solutions across lead capture, Voice AI engagement, qualification, CRM updates, human handover and sales conversion.
Architect and deploy enterprise Voice AI, Conversational AI, AI Agents and LLM-based solutions.
Integrate Voice AI with CRM, Marketing Automation, WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Telephony, Contact Centres, CDPs, APIs and analytics platforms.
Lead enterprise solutioning, discovery workshops, technology consulting, architecture and client presentations.
Drive measurable business outcomes including lead contact rate, speed-to-lead, qualification rate, cost per qualified lead, appointment generation and lead-to-opportunity conversion.
Evaluate and select technologies across LLMs, Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Orchestration, Telephony, Agentic AI and Automation platforms.
Build reusable Voice AI frameworks, accelerators and AI-led delivery processes.
Build and lead multidisciplinary teams across AI/LLM Engineering, Voice AI, Solution Architecture, CRM Integration, Marketing Automation, Conversation Design, Data and Delivery.
Partner with senior stakeholders including CMOs, CROs, Heads of Sales, CIOs, CTOs and Digital leaders.



Mandatory Experience

15+ years of experience in technology-led customer acquisition, digital transformation, CRM, demand generation, sales technology or customer engagement.
Minimum 2 years of substantial hands-on experience implementing Voice AI / Conversational AI solutions.
Proven experience taking Voice AI solutions from prototype/PoC to live enterprise production deployment.
Strong understanding of Voice AI, Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, APIs, system integration and enterprise architecture.
Strong knowledge of CRM, Lead Management, Marketing Automation, Digital Acquisition and Demand Generation.
Experience integrating AI/Voice solutions with enterprise CRM, marketing and sales ecosystems.
Experience leading technology teams and enterprise client engagements.
Strong solution consulting, architecture and communication skills.



Preferred

Experience with Agentic AI, multilingual Voice AI, Indian languages, high-volume inbound/outbound customer acquisition, Martech, Contact Centre technology, Salesforce, HubSpot, CDP, digital transformation or AI-led product/service development will be highly preferred.




Who Should Apply?

This role is ideal for a Voice AI / Conversational AI / GenAI / Martech / CRM / Digital Transformation leader who can combine AI + Technology + Marketing + CRM + Automation + Sales to build scalable enterprise customer acquisition solutions.

This is a practice-building leadership role, not a pure Voice AI developer position.




Interested? WhatsApp: Dimple - 9967194186
Email: shrikrishivhr@gmail.com




If your experience matches the above requirements, please share your updated CV with "Voice AI Leader - Mumbai" as the subject line.
